title: Beach Boys: The Perfect Date
description: In love the most important thing is confidence. Show that you are a seducer and win the heart of the boy of your dreams. Don't lie! If you fail he will know it and you won't conquer his love. Features: - As you advance the questions start to get more personal. - More than 20 different questions. - Different endings depending on how many questions you answer. - Open chests to unlock images of the boys on the beach. - Unveil the secret and spicy question that they will ask you in question 150. Remember not to lie! Prove your ability to win a boy's heart.
